note: FP has not seen Plus-train data. Validation (300 Plus-train observations) chose all P1 fine-tune hyperparameters and early stopping; the Plus test subset was never used for selection. A8 rows are excluded from method selection. RAQ-FT v1 (all parameter groups at lr 3e-4) degraded every monitor (validation readout 764 to 1277, KV error doubled) because the FP16 row scales drifted 19%; it was stopped without Plus evaluation and replaced by v2 with magnitude-matched per-group learning rates (EXPERIMENTS.md E089).
